external_references.description: FBI, CISA, CNMF, NCSC-UK. (2022, February 24). Iranian Government-Sponsored Actors Conduct Cyber Operations Against Global Government and Commercial Networks. Retrieved September 27, 2022.

objects.description: [PowGoop](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1046) has used a DLL named Goopdate.dll to impersonate a legitimate Google update file.(Citation: DHS CISA AA22-055A MuddyWater February 2022)
objects.description_fa: [PowGoop](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1046) از یک DLL به نام Goopdate.dll برای جعل هویت یک فایل به‌روزرسانی قانونی Google استفاده کرده است.(Citation: DHS CISA AA22-055A MuddyWater February 2022)
